# Chess.com review icons

The icons live in `.github/review-icons`. GitHub review comments cannot load a
repository-relative image source such as `.github/review-icons/brilliant.png`.
Use this raw GitHub URL instead (replace `feat/emojis` with the branch that
contains the icons after they are merged):

```html
<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jannabiforever/eqn/feat/emojis/.github/review-icons/brilliant.png" width="18">
```
